description: This file defines the AppDatabase class which manages the app's local SQLite database. It includes methods for opening the database, creating schema tables, and performing CRUD operations related to downloads, watch history, recent searches, and download queue status.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: A singleton-like class that encapsulates database connection, schema creation, and data operations for downloads, watch history, recent searches, and download queue state.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the SQLite database, initializing schema if necessary. Uses in-memory database for test environments.

methods.name: upsertWatchProgress
methods.description: Adds or updates the watch position for a content ID.

methods.name: getWatchProgressSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves the last saved watch position in seconds for a specific content ID.

methods.name: getRecentWatchHistory
methods.description: Returns a list of recent watch history entries ordered by most recent update.

methods.name: upsertRecentSearch
methods.description: Adds or updates a recent search query.

methods.name: getRecentSearches
methods.description: Retrieves recent search queries ordered by most recent.

methods.name: hasDownload
methods.description: Checks if a download exists for a specific content ID.

methods.name: getDownloadStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current download status for a content ID.

methods.name: getDownloadQueuePaused
methods.description: Returns whether the download queue is currently paused.

methods.name: setDownloadQueuePaused
methods.description: Sets the paused state of the download queue.

properties.name: _db
properties.description: Internal reference to the Database instance.

classes.name: WatchHistoryEntry
classes.description: A data class representing an entry in the watch history table, including content ID, position in seconds, and last updated timestamp.
